title: Linear Circuit Wizard
text: Generate or modify linear circuit, {Frequency [min,max]} sets Minimum control frequency; {Circuit design name} sets the name of circuit displayed on block icon, {Netlist file name} sets the name of netlist file that defines circuit character, {Configuration name} sets the name of configuration file character, {Parse netlist file and start new configuration} sets the parse named netlist, {Save configuration} sets the save current configuration, {Load configuration} sets the load existing configuration, {Attach configuration to block} sets the attach selected configuration file to Simulink, {Build Simulink block} sets the create Simulink block or object to model circuit defined by netlist, {Pole/zero report} adds pole -zero report to base workspace, {Transfer function plot} plots transfer functions, {Linear control system} adds matrices for control system differential equations to base, {Analyze}, {Output port} sets the outport port for primary output value drop-down menu created from port, {Steady state output value(s)} sets the desired primary output value, {Primary control variable} sets the variable used to regulate output Duty, {Duty cycle value [min,max]} sets the minimum control duty cycle, {Phase offset(s)} sets the phase of rising edge of control signal as fraction of control, {Pulse Duration(s)} sets the pulse duration of control signal as function of control, {Samples per waveform} sets the number of samples in single switching cycle output and {Analyze operating point} sets the operating point analysis of switched circuit. Values come from the instance.
